name: Starry Wisp
summary: Ranged spell attack for 1d8 Radiant damage; the target glows and can't benefit from being Invisible.
text: Make a ranged spell attack against one creature or object within range. On a hit it takes 1d8 Radiant damage, and until the end of your next turn it sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and gains no benefit from the Invisible condition. The damage becomes 2d8 at character level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.
